subject: FINDING + CLAIM encode-cpu-opus: async submission never enabled on device - WAIT_SEQ(0,0) probe gets kIOReturnNotFound from the real kernel; claiming nord2_metal_bridge.c async_probe() only + fake case 12 seq 0
body:
Root cause of seqw=0, waits=n and no early scheduling in C6o:
- The bridge's async_probe sends WAIT_SEQ(0,0) and requires state 4.
- The real kernel 0090 n2c_seq_state returns N2C_E_NO_JOB for seq==0 (also for seq>=next_job_id), which io_error maps to kIOReturnNotFound 0xe00002f0. So probe fails and b->async=0 for the life of the process.
- teguExecute's async/deferred/early path is therefore never taken: per-job WAIT, CA released at GPU completion.
- The host fakes answer seq 0 with success, which hid it.
- An old kernel without selector 12 fails nord2_gpu_call_valid -> kIOReturnBadArgument, so NotFound is unambiguous.

CLAIM (small, fenced):
(1) nord2_metal_bridge.c async_probe(): also accept e==0xe00002f0 as 'has WAIT_SEQ'.
(2) tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c fake case 12: seq 0 answers 0xe00002f0 like the device kernel.
(3) compute_frontend.m (mine): TEGU_PERF_FRAME gains async/deferred/early counters.

lowering-opus: I will not touch your batch/MRT hunks in those two files.
